phase: Frozen before reading any current degree_two implementation/checker
checker_interface: Python stdlib only; trees are integer leaves or length-two JSON lists, addresses are Boolean tuples; full undirected parent/child graph; support is union of paths between selected leaf occurrences; restriction is unary-suppressed unordered labelled shape; partition checks exact label cover, nonempty duplicate-free disjoint blocks, matching restrictions, and pairwise support disjointness separately in both trees.
failure_criterion: Any exact inequality, missing expected control, unrecognized corruption, in-regime missing valid two-block refinement, or unexpected exception fails closed. Out-of-regime fires do not refute target.
pilot: Only frozen fixtures plus all unordered binary trees on {0,1,2}, all nonempty common label subsets and all support vertices. Stop on counterexample. No larger census.
lean_controls: Rebuild positive twins; false proposition is semantic evidence only if well-typed proposition is rejected because decide evaluates false. Syntax/type/import errors are diagnostic only.
